title: Apple Hits First Ever $5 Trillion Market Cap

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Shares of the company rose to $348.15 on Oct. 13, marking the 22nd time the stock has reached an all-time high during 2026. This price surge pushed Apple's total market valuation above $5 trillion for the first time in its history, placing the electronics giant alongside Nvidia as one of the two most valuable corporations in the world.

The valuation milestone coincides with the launch of HomeView, a $299 smart home display that personalizes Siri and connects to home cameras and locks to maintain a hardware edge over AI agents from Meta, Google, and Amazon. Meanwhile, Microsoft and Meta shares are also trading near their own record peaks.
